spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶2:** When the [GAP-1] celestial good first proceeding from the Divine went forth into combat against the assault of [GAP-2] evil and falsity, clothed in an external truth [GAP-3] against the realm of falsity from evil, clothed in the truth-form of [GAP-4] celestial love itself — by that truth-form animated by love it withered the inflation of self-love in the adversary; it cast down the insanity and the emptiness of falsity.

---

**¶-3:** Now, celestial love alone was sufficient to subdue them. Yet, because celestial love in its proceeding was weakened through contact with what opposed it, the Divine adjoined to it four further truth-coverings: that of spiritual thought, that of natural truth, that of the understanding of wisdom, and that of the rational sphere of spiritual life. And why were these four given? They were given so that they would serve as supports to that divine principle which is celestial love; so that [GAP-5] falsity from evil would not [GAP-6] overwhelm celestial love and penetrate into it; and so that the destructive falsity and the opposition of evil would not sever it from its source.

---

**¶4:** While celestial love received a blow and a wound in its external form, yet still [GAP-7] all the powers of falsity from evil were restrained because of its sacrifice. [GAP-8] It [GAP-9] was by necessity [GAP-10] that its coordinate faculties also had to receive harm and wounding. The potency of evil was adulterated into them. However, except [GAP-11] the rational sphere of spiritual life — falsity from evil did not adulterate it, nor was the consuming fire of self-love able to penetrate into it.

---

**¶5:** Nevertheless, even the one that remained behind without wound — which is the rational sphere of spiritual life — it relinquished its own truth-covering and its own power. It communicated these to its four coordinate faculties in its own stead, so that by the truth-form of the living rational sphere they would be strengthened, and [GAP-12] would receive spiritual benefit, and would endure — namely, its other four coordinate faculties. And it [GAP-13] became for them the inmost vivifying principle — their very life.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: When the [First] Man came forth against the ene[my, clothed in a] garment [against] the Darkness with the garment of [the] living fire. With that garment he withered the tumescence (?) of the enemy; he brought down i[t]s foolery and its vanity.

Now, this one alone was sufficient for them. [Y]et, si[n]ce the living fire was weakened, because of this he added [to it another fou]r garments: that of the wind, that of the water, that of the light, and that of the a[i]r. And this, (why) has he given the four? He gave them s[o] th[a]t they would be helpe[r]s to t[h]at god, wh[ich i]s the living fire; so that [the enemy would] not with [in] the living f[ire], and penetrate it; and [the po]ison and the [enmi]ty cut it off.

While the fire received a bl[ow and] a wound in its body; yet still, [were weakened] all the powers of Da[rk]ness because of it [Yet also] It [was of] necessity [for its] brothers, to cause them to receive a blow and a woun[d to]o. The power of the en/emy mixed in with them. Rath[er, ex]cept [the air]. The Darkness did not mix in with it, nor was the burning of the enemy able to penet/rate it.

Never-theless, even the one that remained behind without the wound, which is the air, it stripped off garment and power. It gave it to its [fo]ur brothers in its place; so that by that [ga]rment of the living air they would become strong, and [receive] profit, and endure, namely its other four brothers. And it [be]came for them [a spirit of] life.

fills.explanation: The "First Man" (Ohrmazd) is the standard Manichaean title for the celestial good first proceeding from the Divine into battle, confirmed throughout the Kephalaia.

The spiritual reading specifies "clothed in an external truth" at this position, requiring a phrase completing "enemy" and introducing "garment" — the First Man came forth against the enemy, clothed in a garment.
The spiritual reading specifies "external truth against the realm of falsity from evil," requiring "against" to connect "garment" to "the Darkness."

The editor's "of" would create a double-preposition ("of of") since "of" already appears in established text before the gap; correcting to "the" gives "the garment of the living fire," consistent with the article pattern used throughout ("the living fire" in ¶3 and ¶5).

The spiritual reading specifies "falsity from evil would not" at this position, requiring the subject of the negative clause — in the Kephalaia's natural register, "the enemy" corresponds to falsity from evil.

Confirming the editor's reading: "with in" renders a Coptic compound preposition meaning "within," and the parallel in ¶4 ("mix in with it") uses the same construction — the helpers prevent the enemy from entering within the living fire.

The spiritual reading says "all the powers of falsity from evil were restrained," requiring a passive verb; "were weakened" matches the chapter's own vocabulary from ¶3 ("the living fire was weakened") and describes the reciprocal effect on Darkness.

The spiritual reading places a sentence break before this gap, requiring a transitional phrase introducing the additional consequence that the fire's brothers also had to suffer — "Yet also" provides both continuation and the additive sense required by the narrative.
The spiritual reading specifies "was by necessity" between "It" and "necessity"; "It was of necessity" is the standard Kephalaia construction expressing divine compulsion.
The spiritual reading specifies "that its coordinate faculties" after "necessity," requiring a prepositional connector to "brothers" — "for its" links necessity to the fire's four brother-elements.

Confirming the editor's reading: the spiritual reading identifies this as "the rational sphere of spiritual life," which corresponds to "the air" throughout the chapter, and ¶5 explicitly confirms "the one that remained behind without the wound, which is the air."

The spiritual reading specifies "would receive spiritual benefit" at this position; "receive" completes the verbal triplet ("become strong / receive profit / endure") in parallel with the other two active constructions.

The spiritual reading specifies "the inmost vivifying principle" — in the Kephalaia's natural register, the air element (pneuma) becomes "a spirit of life" for its brothers, expressing the vivifying soul-principle that animates from within.

assessment: 8 restored, 1 already filled, 4 editorial reviewed (3 confirmed, 1 corrected)
